positive_snippets: Great hotel with a fantastic location. Mr. Pravesh, the Manager, was particularly helpful and polite throughout our visit. His proactive attitude made a huge difference in our experience. I will definitely be returning🤞🤞
negative_snippets: Centrally located but the hotel is not in a good shape . It’s under maintained and not work the price you pay. Nothing like what you see on booking.com or Agoda. Doesn’t have a place for reception or dining both are in one dingy corner . Rooms entrance through a small tiny living space where people can smoke with NO ventilation. Rolled up mattress and blankets kept on the floor where I believe the helped rest at night . So not a very GK2 experience in Delhi .

This is one of the worst stays i have ever been too i reached late at night around 1 AM. Even after multiple calls no one was answering for the location. Once i finally managed to find it. I went into the room. I have never been to a room like this ever in my travelling. The room was smelling mold and it was in mid feb so the climate out side was cold.
